title: AXIAL / STATE × TRANSFORM
hypothesis: Discrete semantic state + continuous embodied transform + explicit transaction commit can reduce translation cost between physical manipulation and computational meaning.
promotion_gate: Do not promote to a root showcase card until the digital 10-trial harness produces an interpretable PASS and one physical nested-tube comparison produces interpretable receipts; root may link the lab as an explicitly gated experiment.
research_question: Can the low-level detent + twist/slide + transaction trace reconstruct what changed without a separate manual narrative?
known_gap: Digital mechanics are proxies. Physical travel, detent force, backlash, eyes-free acquisition, nonlinear mappings, and mechanical state persistence remain unvalidated.
